labeling: Authored 2026-09-14 by the MergePilot team against the synthetic corpus BEFORE any baseline was measured. One family = one user intent; all paraphrases of an intent stay inside the same family. Labels are the document (and, where the document has more than one chunk, the chunk) a correct retrieval must rank first.
split_rule: Split is by family, never by query: every family listed in heldout_families is held-out in full, every other family is tuning. Held-out results may be computed exactly once per promoted strategy; strategy selection uses tuning families only.
